g.text: cti-expert v2.12 — end-to-end tool & skill flow (one skill, two layers)
domain · URL · IP · email · username · phone · wallet · hash · APK · onion
no_spend / no-contact posture gates every later phase
reuse a finished scan, or start one and
owner -> edges · kit / neighbour -> facts only
keyless first, premium if keyed · entitlement measured per case · every call under CTI_CALL_TIMEOUT (5000 s)
favicon · trackers · wallets · emails · phones · Telegram · WHOIS eras · TLS · JARM
· crypto reference + token contracts = facts, never clusters
ran · empty · error · timed_out · skipped_no_key · skipped_policy — failed layers are re-runnable
signing cert · package · permissions · embedded C2 · Firebase · S3 · wallets
same graph as the web infra
kb_ingest (ingest_webpivot · noise_filters decide fact vs edge)
cross-type harness loop — every selector type is a node
co-tenancy guards hold shared certs / IPs back as
(read-only PLAN_TOOLS) re-ranks · drops · adds cross-type pivots
rows rung-aware -> typed nodes · new owner-linked domains seed the next round
only registrant e-mail / phone is a decisive join key
case graph -> PNG / SVG / Mermaid + lifecycle timeline
+ relationship graph + chosen presentation (PDF / DOCX / HTML / all)
(work from a cold prompt, any project)
<target> recall -> intake -> Quarry -> harness loop | pipeline
<seed> have I seen this before? — run first
backend tier · MCP tools · credit balances
egress proxy / rotation pool for every collector
once the skill is loaded via /cti or /cti-expert.
Premium keys only upgrade a tier;
a missing key degrades to a note, never breaks the run.
